name: Critical Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公告新的业务扩张、收缩或合约；已披露事项主要为股本发行相关公司行动及末期股息。最新季度营收同比-6.9%，全年营收同比-6.9%，净利润同比-20.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company announced no new business expansion, contraction, or contracts; disclosed items were mainly share issuance corporate actions and a final dividend. Latest quarter revenue declined 6.9% YoY, full-year revenue declined 6.9% YoY, and net profit declined 20.4% YoY.
